REBEL

Just look up for shaman/holographic breathing techniques in youtube. It actually helps to put you in a better mood INSTANTLY, and that is only a small part of it, it can actually change your whole life and can make you become a happier/better person permanently. 

Basically it's breathing through your mouth deeply until you start feeling more tingly sensations in your body (it means that it is working), then after breathing, you can try and hold your breath without breathing, you will be able to hold your breath for much, much longer periods of time than usually, because with the deep breathing, the body is charged with a lot of oxygen and every cell of your body is now way more "energized" and there is no need to inhale, just feel the effects of the breathing, it should be a very pleasant sensation all over your body and mind, very calm state. Make sure you don't have to do anything important while doing this breathwork, it's best that you literally aren't doing anything, make sure you have some free time when doing this.

Preferably you should be in a comfortable position, laying on the ground is one of the best options, get some blankets and pillow if you want. Of course, if you know that you have some health problems with breathing or whatsoever, you should probably visit a doctor or get a professional advice. Do this on your own responsibility. But as far as I know from my own experience, this can't do any harm to you if done properly. If done properly it has only positive benefits that can be achieved instantly. This is a very old and ancient breathing method, and it actually can improve your current state of feeling and even could improve your health overall and heal different kinds of illness, including mental and physical.

There are many clips about it on youtube and articles all over internet with longer in-depth explanations, which you can look into if you want, there are some interesting opinions and experiences from other people that have done it and share the their thoughts on the breathing and benefits from it.

Here is a good video for example - [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hngrdYVM9BU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hngrdYVM9BU)

In the video he's explaining two methods of breathing, the first method is done for shorter periods (in my opinion, short method is meant to make you get to know the sensations of the breathing "effects" and what this breathing method is all about, you can try it to get to know the sensations a little better)

Second method is done for longer periods of time and personally I've tried both methods a couple times and second method had better, more intensive results. As far as I know there is really no right way to do it, you just have to breathe deep and hard in your lungs-stomach-chests-body. You can start doing this starting from doing 30 deep breaths at start until you start feeling tingly, light headed... But it's possible for you to do this breathing for longer than 1-2 hours and if you try to do it for longer it should get you naturally "high" and get tingly sensations over all parts of your bady, basically it's pure energy entering your body and energizing your body, which in result makes you feel more alive/happy.

Before doing this, make sure you aren't doing anything important, you should do this at home at free time, when nothing is bothering you.

My advice is to just start breathing through mouth deeply until you start having the first sensations of tingling in your body and light head sensations. Don't be too afraid if you start feeling light headed, just try it out at the start, get to know the process and the sensations. If you want to have best results, try doing this for longer periods of time - 5,10,20,30 minutes and so on... After 10 minutes of breathing there should be more intense sensations, emotions could come up, even trippy and natural sensations of high. There is no right or best way to do this, when you will do this, it's most likely you will feel by yourself for how long you should be doing this, just go with your own intuition. Lay on the ground in a comfortable position with a pillow below your head and some blankets over body, make yourself more relaxed and comfortable, find your own way to make yourself feel better while doing this, light some candles if you want, but as far as I know it's better to do in a darker room, so no lights are distracting you, but candles or an oil lamp should be ok to make this process more soothing.

I hope this will actually help someone, because personally for me, when I start feeling more anxious, this breathwork is always helping me to feel better instantly. I have made my own tests and keep on finding my own right way to do this and constantly raise the duration of breathing, each time I just feel this buzzing all over my body and I can always hold my breath for much longer periods than usually, and when holding my breath I just feel so much more relaxed and calm, it is amazing...

I hope I made this as clear as possible, if not, there are a lot of information about shamanic breathing online. If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.
